message: So, the other day, I found myself organizing my pantry for the umpteenth time. You know you’ve reached a new level of preparedness when you have enough canned beans to feed a small army—during a hurricane or a snowstorm! My grandkids think I’m just gloriously over-prepared, but I like to think of it as ‘strategically stocked.’ Besides, who wouldn’t want a taco night during a blizzard? What’s your most amusing preparedness story?
